title: Shuttle v3: constraint register (step 1 of 7)
status: DRAFT for kT. Read from main @ the B4-S merge (PR #567). Values cite their source; nothing is invented.

classes.HARD: installed Wayfarer geometry, canon, or physics: cannot change without changing Wayfarer or canon
classes.CRITERION: a certification margin in cert_criteria.json: real and enforced, but a margin choice; changing it is a kT/class:governance decision with a stated basis
classes.POLICY: a kT-set number (envelope, floor): real only because kT chose it
classes.CANDIDATE: an engineering candidate value that can be resized at a mass cost

wayfarer_fit.value: radius 2.4 m about the ship axis
4.8 m wide (|y| <= 2.4) on +Z; two clamshell doors open to vertical at the slot edges
tubes d 0.4 m at y +-2.75, z 2.6 (inner edge |y| 2.55)
nearest edge |y| ~2.42 on the exit path

wayfarer_fit.what: Hot fins aft of the bay
wayfarer_fit.value: x 34.3-53.3 m, 2.25 m aft of the bay, >= 1.0 m from the slot edge lines

wayfarer_fit.what: Docking: pressure-tight transfer tunnel ends at a nose port
wayfarer_fit.value: port at x 18.75 m on the bay axis; the shuttle must dock nose-first on its long axis there
>= 0.25 m, so the stowed shuttle fits inside r 2.15 m
>= 0.5 m, so stowed length <= 12.8 m including the nose port
>= 0.5 m to slot edges, open doors, longerons and strake grooves, so the shuttle's width ACROSS the slot (stowed attitude) <= 3.8 m
back 0.5 m off the nose port, then rise +Z through the slot; any roll attitude allowed (B4-S rides rolled 90 deg)

mass_and_loads.what: Wayfarer dry mass and ECON reach are fixed
mass_and_loads.value: dry 868.192255 t, ECON dv 707.845 km/s; every shuttle tonne comes out of the reserve

mass_and_loads.what: Reserve available above the floor today

mass_and_loads.value: kT-approved assumption, raised from 34.2 on 2026-11-19. NOT a physical limit. Proposed: retire it and use M5, M6 and M2 instead
5 g x 1.5 = 7.5 g: the berth must hold the docked shuttle at 7.5 g
4 x 0.75 MN rated = 3.0 MN: holds up to 40.8 t at 7.5 g (lug shear limit 48.9 t). Heavier shuttle needs bigger latches, paid from reserve

mass_and_loads.what: Ship thrust trim with the shuttle aboard (G3)
mass_and_loads.value: <= 0.5 deg; worst today 0.356 deg (S6). A heavier or off-axis shuttle eats this margin

mass_and_loads.what: Shuttle propellant comes from Wayfarer's remass
mass_and_loads.value: each tonne of shuttle water costs Wayfarer 3.25 km/s of ECON reach unless refilled at a port (23.1 t = 74 km/s)
mass_and_loads.source: certify.g8 note; ECON ve 3,000 km/s, S1 remass 245.4 t

mass_and_loads.value: 56.1 m3 left for the 50 t payload AND the Venus kit; a kit must fit there or ride in the shuttle

derived_envelope.section: inside a circle r 2.15 m about the bay axis, AND <= 3.8 m wide across the slot in the stowed attitude (any roll)
derived_envelope.examples: a 3.8 x 2.0 m box fits; B4-S (4.25 x 2.45 m) fits only rolled 90 deg
derived_envelope.wings: any span > 4.3 m must fold or retract for stowage
derived_envelope.mass_t: set by M2 (reserve), M6 (latches) and M7 (trim), not by M4
derived_envelope.propellant: set by mission dv, but every tonne carried from Wayfarer costs 3.25 km/s of Wayfarer reach (M8)

missions_physics_draft: see SHUTTLE_V3_CONSTRAINTS.md section 3 (reference missions for kT to set)

water.value: 10 m (~2 bar outside) on all doors, hatches, folds, vents
>= 50% at heaviest water-landing mass; 75.6 t (52.5 ceiling + 23.1 water) -> >= 110.6 m3 watertight volume; B4-S 82.45 m3 gives 12%
torch and belly thruster exits above floating waterline + 1.0 m wave at that mass
in 2 m waves; rover bay is a floodable well with W1-rated bulkhead to the cabin; flooded bay volume excluded from W2
water.source: B4-S side door x 8.45-11.7 in lower flank

water.value: ~600 m rating (92 bar / 1.5); 6.7 m3 displaces 6.87 t vs shell+fittings 4.51 t -> trim to neutral; tether or acoustic link
upright and stable, well flooded and empty
